title: census.py apply and factdiff.py apply write the same census.phase token, so the query log report cannot tell the phase-2 outcomes from factdiff's apply
goal: census.py apply records its census.phase row under the phase token census-apply, which factdiff.py's apply does not write, and querylog.md and tools.md name it

run:
import os, runpy, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import ql_capture
seen = []
def fake(phase, run, date):
    seen.append(phase)
    return 0
ql_capture.census_phase = fake
t = tempfile.mkdtemp()
log = os.path.join(t, "2026-01-01.csv")
open(log, "w").write("id\n")
res = os.path.join(t, "r.json")
open(res, "w").write("{}")
def phase(script, argv):
    seen.clear()
    sys.argv = [script] + argv
    try:
        runpy.run_path(os.path.join("_tools", script), run_name="__main__")
    except SystemExit:
        pass
    return seen[0] if seen else None
c = phase("census.py", ["apply", log, "--group", "g", "--from", res])
f = phase("factdiff.py", ["apply", log])
print("census.py apply writes", c, "; factdiff.py apply writes", f)
sys.exit(0 if c and f and c != f else 1)

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import ql_capture
t = "census-apply"
docs = [p for p in ("kb/_self/querylog.md", "kb/_self/tools.md") if t not in open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()]
print("token valid:", bool(ql_capture.OPS_TOKEN.fullmatch(t)), "; docs not naming", t + ":", docs)
sys.exit(1 if docs or not ql_capture.OPS_TOKEN.fullmatch(t) else 0)
